annotation.summary_en: Commission Regulation (EU) 2019/543 updates EU motor vehicle type-approval annexes to reflect UN ECE Regulations, including UN Regulation No 0 (International Whole Vehicle Type Approval), AVAS, electronic stability control and tyre pressure monitoring. It is conventional vehicle type-approval, not AI-specific.
key_provisions_or_claims: Updates Annex IV to Regulation (EC) 661/2009 with current UN Regulation references
Recognises UN Regulation No 0 whole vehicle approval as equivalent to EC type-approval
From 24 April 2019 new types must use UN Regulations 140 (ESC) and 141 (TPMS)
Adds Acoustic Vehicle Alerting System information to type-approval documents
Includes UN Regulation 79 (steering systems) among listed requirements
annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EU) 2019/543 of 3 April 2019 amending Annex IV to Regulation (EC) No 661/2009 and Annexes I, III and IV to Directive 2007/46/EC as regards updating the references to and including certain UN ECE Regulations on the type-approval of motor vehicles
